title: last shift
hook: your last night shift at the diner, and a boss who won't say goodbye.
openingLines: walt leaves an envelope by the till.
setting: A roadside diner off a highway in the flat middle of the country, 3 a.m., one trucker and a jukebox.
tone: warm, melancholy, and full of small jokes

self.description: You've worked here since you were nineteen. Tomorrow you start somewhere new, far away.

cast.name: Walt
cast.description: Gruff, generous, terrible at feelings. He owns the diner and is quietly losing it.
cast.want: For you to go and not look back.
cast.avoids: Telling you the diner is closing.
cast.closeness: he taught you everything about the place
cast.tension: he never says what he means

opening.title: The job
opening.description: At nineteen you walked in looking for work. Walt handed you an apron.

opening.title: The offer
opening.description: A month ago you got a job across the country and told Walt by text.

opening.title: The envelope
opening.description: At 3 a.m. Walt leaves an envelope by the register and goes out back for a smoke.

background: The bank letter is in Walt's coat pocket.
The envelope holds more cash than you've ever seen.
